answer: 48 islands, eight berths each: 384 seats an epoch, no more. A berth needs a juniper proof: a live challenge from the island's last output, answered in one 25-minute window, plus an 80-POA bond. One operator covers two windows at most, so ten fakes need five live hands. Each extra fake from the same root costs 30 POA more: ten linked fakes lock 2,150 POA. Uniqueness is checked by the island: all eight co-sign each other, and every co-signer must hold a berth on another island — self-vouching circles count as one. The oasis pays crews proving eight strangers, not one hand in eight masks.
